edits.before: Q off minions to chip the duo — the angles are the lane and every wave drops souls.
edits.after: Q outranges Starcall's arc; poke freely while Equinox is down.

edits.before: Soul discipline begins: collect what's safe; the range grows forever.
edits.after: Equinox's cooldown at this level leaves long poke windows between casts.

edits.before: W threats open: any clumped trade risks the spreading root.
edits.after: Full kit online, but her heals can't keep pace with root-into-poke damage.

edits.before: Chip the ledger and bank the souls — the collection out-scales every support item.
edits.after: Astral Infusion sustains through your poke, evening the trade.

edits.before: Dawning Shadow online — the global beam saves dives and finishes recalls.
edits.after: Wish heals her whole team globally — burst before it lands, not after.

edits.before: First item: the Q chunks and the soul thresholds start mocking trade math.
edits.after: Her heal-per-mana out-sustains your poke until anti-heal lands.

edits.before: Late Senna out-ranges the game from the support slot — souls, beams, and mist.
edits.after: Anti-heal and global R let you out-damage her sustain entirely.

edits.before: - Soraka Equinox: matchup-defining — The silence zone cancels your engage mid-cast — step out before the root snaps. It writes your spacing rules. - E Curse of the Black Mist is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: Equinox (E) is down 20s at rank 1, falling to 16s at rank 5 — it silences you for its duration, so hold your combo rather than pre-casting into it.

edits.before: A sustain mirror your souls out-scale — chip the angles and let the collection decide the second half.
edits.after: She out-sustains chip damage — root through Equinox's silence window and answer her heals with anti-heal.

edits.before: Out-collect the mirror — infinity wins sustain wars. The lane runs on Equinox’s cooldown — book your windows against it.
edits.after: Poke through her sustain and time your all-in around Equinox's cooldown, not into it.

edits.before: Soraka wins by landing Equinox, denying your pattern, and healing through your math until your windows expire.
edits.after: Soraka wins by landing Equinox to silence your answer, then out-healing your poke with Astral Infusion and Wish.

edits.before: - Senna vs Soraka - Track: Soraka Equinox. - Track his engage cooldown — your duo trades only when it's down. - Equinox spent means windows open. - Keep the ult for the swing moment.
edits.after: - Senna vs Soraka - Track: Equinox (E) cooldown — it silences your escape, so never pre-cast into it. - Astral Infusion and Wish both apply Grievous Wounds targets; buy anti-heal early. - Root through her sustain, don't out-race it.
